p.title: Outbound fetches had a header-only deadline and the SEC client had none
p.symptom: fetchJSON and the RSS fetch cleared their timer before the body was read and fetchJSON retried a definitive 4xx; the SEC client had no deadline, so a provider that stalled after the headers could hold the lane until the job timeout.
p.root_cause: Timers were cleared right after the response arrived.
p.fix: The timer is cleared in finally after the body read, a 4xx other than 408/429 is not retried, and every SEC request carries AbortSignal.timeout(60s).
p.violated_rule: Every outbound call needs one total deadline.
p.prevention: Syntax and existing producer contracts; no network test is possible in the sandbox.
p.verification: Node syntax check and the data-pipeline gate. Not done: retry jitter and Retry-After handling.
